about.title: About GTAI
about.intro: GTAI stands for Global Travel AI. It is a multilingual travel-discovery and metasearch platform developed by GROUPE AMERI INC., a company based in Quebec, Canada.

sections.heading: What GTAI is building
body: GTAI is designed to compare travel options across providers and explain the trade-offs between them in plain language, rather than presenting a single unexplained ranking.
AI-supported trip planning is part of the product direction: structured questions that build a trip profile, instead of an empty chat box.

sections.heading: What the current public version does
body: The public version you are using runs a complete search, comparison, filtering and detail experience against demonstration flight data generated locally by GTAI.
Airlines, booking providers, schedules and prices in those results are fictional. They exist so the product's behaviour can be reviewed end to end before any live data is connected.

sections.heading: Travel-provider integrations
body: Live travel-provider integrations require commercial and technical approval. Until an approved integration is activated, GTAI's results remain demonstration data.
No partnership, endorsement or affiliation with any travel company should be inferred from this public version.

sections.heading: What GTAI does not do today
body: GTAI does not sell tickets, issue travel documents or process payments. No booking contract is formed through this website.

contact.title: Contact
contact.intro: Partnership, technical and general inquiries are welcome by email.
contact.note: GTAI does not operate a contact form and does not collect contact details through this website. Email is the only channel offered, and messages are answered from the address above.

privacy.title: Privacy
privacy.intro: This notice describes how the current public version of GTAI handles information. It is written to match what the product actually does today, not what it may do later.

sections.heading: No account is required
body: You can explore flight search on GTAI without creating an account. GTAI does not ask for your name, address, date of birth or payment details.

sections.heading: What happens when you search
body: The search parameters you choose — route, dates, travellers, cabin and currency — are sent to GTAI's own internal server route, which generates demonstration results and returns them to your browser.

GTAI does not intentionally attach anything else to that request: no account identifier, no passenger identity, no passport data and no payment data. Normal web delivery still involves technical request data such as your IP address, User-Agent and request headers, which infrastructure providers may process.

Those parameters also appear in the page address so a search can be shared or reopened. A URL can therefore remain in your browser history, and anyone you share the link with can see the search it describes.

sections.heading: No booking or payment data
body: GTAI does not process bookings or payments, so no passenger, passport or payment information is collected anywhere in this version.

sections.heading: Storage in your browser
body: When you pick an airport or city, GTAI stores the identifiers of your recent selections in your browser's `sessionStorage` so it can offer them again. Only entity identifiers are kept — no typed text, no coordinates and no traveller data.

`sessionStorage` is tab-scoped browser storage, not a cookie. It is not sent with requests, it normally disappears when you close the tab or the browsing session, and GTAI does not use it as an analytics identifier.

sections.heading: Server-side records
body: GTAI's search runtime builds a privacy-minimized audit-event shape for each internal search. That shape deliberately excludes your route, dates, traveller counts, the full search parameters, and any request or response content.

In this release the default sink does not persist those events — GTAI does not operate a persistent application-level search audit log. That is a statement about GTAI's own application, not about hosting: infrastructure logs may still exist. Introducing persistent auditing later would require a retention and access policy first.
No travel-provider credentials exist in the code delivered to your browser.

sections.heading: Infrastructure providers
body: GTAI is hosted by third-party infrastructure providers. Those providers may process limited technical information — such as the IP address and request metadata inherent to delivering a web page — to operate and secure the service. GTAI does not claim that no infrastructure logs exist.

sections.heading: Analytics and tracking
body: GTAI has not intentionally enabled any analytics product, tag manager, advertising tracker or third-party chat widget in this version.
No non-essential cookies are set by GTAI, which is why this site shows no cookie banner.

sections.heading: Questions
body: Privacy questions can be sent to the public contact address. This notice describes current practice; it is not a claim of formal compliance certification under any specific regulation.

terms.title: Terms of Use
terms.intro: These terms apply to your use of the GTAI website in its current public form. Please read them together with the Privacy notice and the Affiliate Disclosure.

sections.heading: Demonstration content
body: Flight itineraries, airlines, booking providers, schedules and prices shown on GTAI are fictional demonstration data generated locally.
This content is not an offer, is not bookable, and must not be relied on when purchasing travel. Prices and itineraries shown here do not correspond to any real flight.

sections.heading: What GTAI is not
body: GTAI does not currently act as an airline, an online travel agency, a travel agent or a payment processor. No ticket is issued through GTAI and no booking contract is formed with GTAI or through this website.

sections.heading: Availability of the service
body: GTAI is under active development. Features, content and this website itself may change, be suspended or become unavailable at any time, without notice.

sections.heading: Acceptable use
body: You may use GTAI for personal, non-commercial travel research. You must not attempt unauthorized access to any part of the service, interfere with its operation, attack it, or scrape it in a way that disrupts availability for others.

sections.heading: Intellectual property
body: The GTAI name, interface and content are the property of GROUPE AMERI INC. or its licensors. Any third-party names or trademarks that may appear remain the property of their respective owners, and their appearance does not imply any endorsement, affiliation or approval.

sections.heading: General

This page is provided for information. It is not legal advice, and it has not been independently reviewed by a lawyer.

affiliateDisclosure.title: Affiliate Disclosure
affiliateDisclosure.intro: This page explains how GTAI intends to make money, and what is and is not happening today.
current: GTAI does not provide live affiliate or booking links in this demonstration release.
The airlines, booking providers and prices shown in results are fictional, so no booking can result from them.
No commission is earned from anything on this website today.
future: GTAI may later work with approved affiliate or referral partners.
GTAI may receive compensation when a traveller follows an approved link and completes a transaction with a third party.
Any booking and payment would take place with that third party, not with GTAI.
Compensation must never change the factual price a provider supplies.
Commercial relationships may influence which options are available or how they are placed. Where that is the case, it will be disclosed on the page where it applies.
